coordinate_semantics: Sapiens2 original raster xy pixels; zero-based template vertex_index
reuse_scope: Only identical template content and unchanged Sapiens2 keypoint definition. Re-detect and raycast each new target; never reuse target coordinates.

calibration.eye_geometry: Original Taro eye meshes, extraction head vertices verified identical to bundled template. Used only for calibration rendering; mapped indices always address the head.
calibration.review: Eye/lip overlay inspected; nose bridge/tip optional, nostril edges and chin inspection only. No complete face contour in this 308-point definition.

scores_note: Raw model scores, not calibrated probabilities; values can exceed one.
